title: The Last Horizon Revisited
author: Dominic Lockridge
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent five years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
